description: Draws a polygon or a star as a pair of voltages, one for the x coordinate and one for the y, for feeding an oscilloscope

params.text: Sets how fast the shape is traced out, one lap of the shape per cycle
Sets how many corners the shape has, 3 to 33
Turns the whole shape about its centre before anything else, -180 to 180 degrees
Sets how far the inner corners of a star fall from the centre as a multiple of the outer ones, -5 to 5; at 1 the shape is a plain polygon
Moves the inner corners of a star round from the midpoint between two outer corners, -5 to 5
Sets how wide the shape is drawn, -10V to 10V at the x output
Sets how tall the shape is drawn, -10V to 10V at the y output
Shifts the whole shape sideways, -10V to 10V added to the x output
Shifts the whole shape up or down, -10V to 10V added to the y output
Turns the shape about the centre of rotation, -720 to 720 degrees
Sets the x coordinate of the point the shape turns about, -10V to 10V
Sets the y coordinate of the point the shape turns about, -10V to 10V
Switched on, the shape spins continuously at the rate set by the rotation knob instead of being held at a fixed angle

inputs.text: Sets how fast the shape is traced out, a volt per octave added to the frequency knob
Sets how many corners the shape has, three corners per volt
Turns the whole shape about its centre, added to the angle offset knob
Sets how far a star's inner corners fall from the centre, added to the inner radius knob
Moves a star's inner corners round from the midpoint, added to the inner angle knob
Sets how wide the shape is drawn, added to the x radius knob
Sets how tall the shape is drawn, added to the y radius knob
Shifts the whole shape sideways, added to the x offset knob
Shifts the whole shape up or down, added to the y offset knob
Turns the shape about the centre of rotation, added to the rotation knob
Sets the x coordinate of the point the shape turns about, added to its knob
Sets the y coordinate of the point the shape turns about, added to its knob
A rising edge here restarts the trace from the first corner

outputs.text: Carries the x coordinate of the point being traced
Carries the y coordinate of the point being traced
Sends a pulse each time the trace passes the first corner, which marks one lap of the shape

notes: patch the two coordinate outputs into the x and y inputs of a scope in lissajous mode to draw the shape; on their own they are two ordinary control voltages
the small screen shows the shape as it is being drawn
a star appears only when the inner radius knob is moved away from 1; at 1 the inner corners fall on the straight edges of the polygon and the shape is a plain one

inputs.12: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
